instruction.text: Harpreet soll für ein Schulprojekt die Geschichte ihrer Familie herausfinden. Um mehr über die Vergangenheit zu lernen, trifft sie sich mit ihrem Urgroßvater Ajit.
instruction.sound: Ha-priet soll für ein Schulprojekt die Geschichte ihrer Familie herausfinden. Um mehr über die Vergangenheit zu lernen, trifft sie sich mit ihrem Ur-Großvater Ajit.

atoms.text: When and how did you come to the UK?

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>Your great-grandmother Shalini and I came to the UK during the 1960s. We travelled by boat. It took nearly six weeks until we arrived here.</prosody>

atoms.a: When did Harpreet's great-grandparents come to the UK?
b: ++They came to the UK in the 1960s.
They came to the UK in 1492.
They came to the UK in 2016.

atoms.a: How did Harpreet's great-grandparents come to the UK?

atoms.text: Why did you come to the UK?

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>After the second world war, there were labour shortages in the UK. They needed more people who were able and willing to work. We saw that as an opportunity for a better future for ourselves and our family.</prosody>

atoms.a: What is one reason why Harpreet's great-grandparents came to the UK?
b: ++There were labour shortages in the UK.
They performed there as part of a theatre group.
They wanted to go on holiday in the UK.

atoms.text: Who came to the UK with you?

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>Your great-grandmother Shalini and your grandmother, who was still a child at that time. You can ask her if she still remembers.</prosody>

atoms.a: Who else came to the UK with Harpreet's great-grandparents?

atoms.text: Harpreet spricht als Nächstes mit ihrer Oma und ihrer Mutter. Sie möchte herausfinden, wie es für die beiden war, im Vereinigten Königreich aufzuwachsen.
atoms.sound: Ha-priet spricht als Nächstes mit ihrer Oma und ihrer Mutter. Sie möchte herausfinden, wie es für die beiden war, im Vereinigten Königreich aufzuwachsen.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2In'>Sat sri akaal</voice> <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3_2025'>bedeutet Hallo auf Punjabi.</voice> <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2In'>Dhī</voice> <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3_2025'>bedeutet Tochter auf Punjabi.</voice> <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2In'>Nani</voice> <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3_2025'>bedeutet Großmutter auf Punjabi.</voice> <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>neither ... nor</voice> <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3_2025'>bedeutet weder ... noch.</voice>

atoms.text: Sat sri akaal! How are you? I'm working on this project from school and have to find out more about how you grew up in the UK. Can I ask you some questions, please?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.5st'>Sat sri akaal! How are you? I'm working on this project from school and have to find out more about how you grew up in the UK. Can I ask you some questions, please?</prosody>

atoms.text: Of course, dhī. What do you need to know?
atoms.sound: Of course, dhī. What do you need to know?

atoms.text: Okay, so first, I'd like to know if you, nānī, remember coming to the UK. Great-grandpa Ajit told me that you came with your parents by boat.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.5st'>Okay, so first, I'd like to know if you, nani, remember coming to the UK. Great-grandpa Ahjiet told me that you came with your parents by boat.</prosody>

atoms.text: That's true, but I don't remember much from that time. I was very young when my parents decided to migrate from India to the UK.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-2.0st'>That's true, but I don't remember much from that time. I was very young when my parents decided to migrate from India to the UK.</prosody>

atoms.text: I understand. How was life like for you back then?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.5st'>I understand. How was life like for you back then?</prosody>

atoms.text: Oh, it was difficult. Neither my parents nor I were good at speaking English. It was hard to build connections at first, but it got better over time.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-2.0st'>Oh, it was difficult. Neither my parents nor I were good at speaking English. It was hard to build connections at first, but it got better over time.</prosody>
ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.5st'>You must have felt lonely.</prosody>

atoms.text: Sometimes, yes. But there were lots of other families in our neighbourhood who also came from India to the UK. That helped a lot.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-2.0st'>Sometimes, yes. But there were lots of other families in our neighbourhood who also came from India to the UK. That helped a lot.</prosody>

atoms.text: Did you struggle with English as well, mum?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.5st'>Did you struggle with English as well, mum?</prosody>

atoms.text: A little bit. I grew up with the English language around me, but at home, we mostly spoke Punjabi.
atoms.sound: A little bit. I grew up with the English language around me, but at home, we mostly spoke Punjabi.

atoms.a: How was life like in the UK for Harpreet's grandmother?
b: ++It was difficult at first because neither her nor her parents were fluent in English.
It was easy because she and her parents grew up with the English language.

atoms.a: What helped Harpreet's grandmother when she felt lonely?
b: ++It helped her to know that there were other families from India in her neighbourhood.
It helped her to know that one day her family would return to India.

atoms.a: What did Harpreet's mum struggle with?
b: ++She struggled with English because at home she only spoke Punjabi.
She struggled with Punjabi because at home she only spoke English.
